title: 'Created me' means appointed, not made in essence
english: The Lord created me (Proverbs 8:22) — Cyril: if you take this of the Godhead, it stands for He appointed me, as in Create a clean heart in me, O God (Psalm 51:10), and that he might create the two in himself (Ephesians 2:15). Not that he would create in essence those already generated, but that he would appoint. So he appointed me a beginning of his providential and making works. And he says to David: I was appointed king by him (Psalm 2:6).
translator_notes: True OET from PG 69 Greek; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
